old_caption: The video captures a dramatic scene of intense flames consuming a mass of material within a circular, dark container. The fire is vividly bright, with hues of orange, yellow, and red dominating the frame. The flames are dynamic, swirling and flickering, creating a sense of movement and urgency. As the video progresses, the fire consumes the material, with the flames shifting and expanding across the surface. The smoke from the fire billows upwards, adding to the chaotic atmosphere. The background remains dark throughout, which emphasizes the brightness and intensity of the flames. There are no visible characters or animals in the scene, focusing entirely on the fiery spectacle. The camera is static, capturing the fire from a fixed angle.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a dramatic scene of intense flames consuming what appears to be a large, circular object, possibly a container or a platform. The fire is vividly bright, with hues of orange, yellow, and red dominating the frame. The flames are dynamic, swirling and flickering, creating a sense of movement and urgency. As the video progresses, the fire engulfs more of the object, causing it to collapse inward, forming a dramatic, almost circular shape. The smoke from the fire billows upwards, adding to the chaotic atmosphere. The background remains dark throughout, which emphasizes the brightness and intensity of the flames. There are no visible characters or animals in the scene, focusing entirely on the fiery spectacle. The camera remains stationary, allowing viewers to fully absorb the raw power and beauty of the fire.
caption: The video captures a turbulent open flame burning low against a black background, resting on a pale curved rim at the bottom and right of the frame. An intensely bright yellow-white core sits within orange-red tongues, while a grey-orange smoke plume gathers to the right. Throughout the excerpt the core flickers, expands and contracts, its centroid wandering across the frame rather than moving as one rigid body. The overall flame mass deforms and tilts, swinging between a long plume leaning left and a more upright column. The luminance pulses, the sharp yellow core dimming into a diffuse orange glow before brightening again into a concentrated mass. Small dark silhouetted fragments embedded in the fire shift position and orientation, carried and re-exposed by the turbulent flow. The smoke region on the right thickens and drifts, at times partially obscuring the curved rim. Combustion continues through the final frame, with no ignition or extinguishing shown.

endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.

collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.

camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
